purpose: Track evidence provenance without claiming technical verification. This registry is documentation/QA metadata; the current app does not yet consume it at runtime.

statusDefinitions.source-not-recorded: No traceable source is recorded in the repository; technical correctness has not been verified by this registry.
statusDefinitions.review-needed: A reviewer has identified a candidate source but has not completed scope/claim verification.
statusDefinitions.verified: A reviewer has checked the cited source against the exact claim and equipment scope. Do not use without at least one reference.

references.title: MD200 User Guide
references.claim: The manual labels Err02 as overcurrent during acceleration and lists output short/ground fault, short acceleration time, unsuitable torque boost/V/f, low voltage, restarting a rotating motor, sudden load, undersized drive, braking resistor fault, and motor ground fault among possible causes.
references.scope: MD200 series AC drive
references.verificationLimit: The cited manual supports this claim for the stated product family; this is not field verification of a particular installed machine.

references.title: MD200 User Guide
references.claim: The manual identifies Err03 as overcurrent during deceleration and lists short/ground faults, short deceleration time, low voltage, sudden load, missing/unsuitable braking resistor, and motor ground fault as possible causes.
references.scope: MD200 series AC drive
references.verificationLimit: The cited manual supports this claim for the stated product family; this is not field verification of a particular installed machine.

references.title: MD200 User Guide
references.claim: The manual labels Err05 as overvoltage during acceleration and lists excessive input voltage, external force driving the motor, short acceleration time, and absent braking resistor as possible causes.
references.scope: MD200 series AC drive
references.verificationLimit: The cited manual supports this claim for the stated product family; this is not field verification of a particular installed machine.

references.title: MD200 User Guide
